# GenZee Video Studio — Comprehensive LLM Context & Platform Documentation

> Comprehensive architecture reference, feature specifications, and platform overview for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI assistants, search bots, and agents.

---

## 1. Platform Identity & Overview
- **Name**: GenZee Video Studio
- **Official Domain**: https://www.genzee.video
- **Category**: Multimedia Creative Studio / All-in-One Creator OS
- **Target Audience**: Video creators, YouTube channel operators, social media marketing agencies, short-form content publishers, and digital brand builders.
- **Value Proposition**: Unifies broadcast-grade text-to-speech voiceover generation, prompt-to-JSON campaign orchestration, multi-platform social scheduling, and YouTube script decomposition in a single, high-performance workspace.

---

## 2. Core Capabilities & Architecture

### A. Multi-Model Broadcast Voice Synthesis
GenZee integrates three leading audio neural model families to provide ultra-realistic, emotionally nuanced narration:
1. **ElevenLabs Neural Engine**:
   - Industry-standard voice cloning and emotive speech synthesis.
   - Pacing control, stability tuning, and dynamic style amplification for long-form video essays and corporate documentaries.
2. **Google Gemini Voice**:
   - Ultra-low-latency, multi-lingual conversational audio synthesis.
   - Ideal for multi-speaker dialogues, conversational podcasts, and rapid shorts generation.
3. **Fish Audio V2.0 Pro**:
   - High-fidelity acoustic modeling with expressive pitch and timbre dynamics.
   - Perfect for viral social media hooks, character voices, and animated narratives.
4. **Studio Audio Mastering**:
   - Uncompressed 48kHz WAV audio rendering and MP3 exports.
   - Real-time waveform scrubbing and multi-track pacing adjustments.

### B. Prompt-to-JSON Campaign Ingestion Pipeline
- **Cross-LLM Interoperability**: Ingest structured JSON campaign strategies generated by ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), or DeepSeek.
- **Calendar Decomposition**: Transforms raw campaign JSON into multi-day social content schedules, video scripts, hashtags, caption variants, and voiceover assignments.
- **Interactive Playground**: Real-time syntax validation, JSON error recovery, and 1-click script narration.

### C. Multi-Platform Social Media Publishing & Scheduling
- **Direct 1-Click Publishing**: Connect Facebook Pages and linked Instagram Professional accounts for direct scheduling and publishing.
- **Realistic Interface Simulators**:
  - Facebook Desktop & Mobile Feed Simulator: Visual preview of captions, link attachments, and image carousels.
  - Facebook & Instagram Reel Simulator: 9:16 vertical video player with creator audio badges, clean follow chips, and realistic engagement UI.
- **Hashtag & Caption Optimizer**: Intelligent hashtag recommendations formatted as clean, clickable pills with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

### D. YouTube Strategy & Script Decomposition Engine
- **Hierarchical Campaign Planning**: Break down broad campaign themes into 1 foundational long-form video essay (8-15 minutes) and 3-5 vertical Shorts (30-60 seconds).
- **Hook Optimization**: Structured first-3-seconds hook formulas with psychological retention cues and audio-visual synchronization tips.

### E. Privacy & Local-First Storage
- **Dual-Mode Persistence**: Seamlessly transitions between authenticated cloud database syncing and 100% offline local IndexedDB storage.
- **Zero Lock-In**: Complete data sovereignty with full JSON export and import capabilities for all projects, audio files, and schedules.
